infoModal.title: Showbox Instructions
infoModal.subtitle: You need to provide your ui cookie from Febbox (ShowBox Provider).

tabs.label: Desktop
tabs.content:
To get the cookie on Windows/Linux browsers:

  1. Log in to your account at Febbox.
  2. Open DevTools (F12 or Right Click > Inspect).
  3. Go to the Application tab (Chrome/Edge) or Storage tab (Firefox).
  4. Select Cookies from the sidebar.
  5. Find and copy the value of the ui cookie.

tabs.label: Mac
tabs.content:
To get the cookie using Safari on Mac:

  1. Enable Develop menu: Safari > Settings > Advanced > Show features for web developers.
  2. Log in at Febbox.com.
  3. Right-click anywhere and select Inspect Element.
  4. Go to the Storage tab, select Cookies, and find the ui cookie.

tabs.label: Android
tabs.content:
To get the cookie on Android:

  1. Install a browser that supports Developer Tools, like:
    • Kiwi Browser (Play Store - GitHub)
    • Lemur Browser (Play Store - GitHub)
    • Yandex Browser (Play Store - GitHub)
  2. Log in at Febbox.com.
  3. Open the browser menu (⋮) and select Developer Tools.
  4. Find the Application (or Storage) tab > Cookies and copy the ui cookie value.

tabs.label: iOS
tabs.content:
To get the cookie on iOS (iPhone/iPad):

  1. Use the Web Inspector app from the App Store.
  2. Log in at Febbox.com using the inspector.
  3. Locate the ui cookie in the Storage/Cookies section.

name: Trakt
description: Configure Trakt credentials. Use 'ClientID' or 'ClientID:AccessToken' (for user details).

infoModal.title: Trakt Authentication
infoModal.subtitle: You can provide just a Client ID, or both Client ID and Access Token for full features.
infoModal.content:
To use Trakt, you minimally need a Client ID. For full features like user profile details, provide both in this format: ClientID:AccessToken

How to get them:

  1. Go to Trakt API Applications and create a new app.
  2. Set the Redirect URI to urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob.
  3. Copy your Client ID and paste it into the field.
  4. Optional: Click Authorize on your app page to generate an Access Token, then enter ClientID:AccessToken.

Alternatively, if you use third-party tools like MDBList, they may provide these values for you.

infoModal.content:
To get your StreamFusion API key, you need to use the official Telegram bot.

  1. Open Telegram and search for the StremioFR bot.
  2. Send the command /generate to the bot.
  3. The bot will provide you with a unique API key.

Paste this key into the "API Key" field in the StreamFusion configuration.

name: TMDB
description: Configure TMDB credentials. A v4 Access Token (Bearer) is recommended to display full profile details, but a v3 API Key also works.

infoModal.title: TMDB - Token vs API Key
infoModal.subtitle: Choosing between Access Token (v4) and API Key (v3).
infoModal.content:
Which credential should I use?

TMDB offers two types of credentials. Both work, but they provide different levels of detail:

  • API Read Access Token (v4 auth): A long string (~100+ chars). This lets AIOStatus fetch your TMDB username and display it on your status card. (Recommended)
  • API Key (v3 auth): A short 32-character hex string. AIOStatus can verify the key works, but cannot retrieve any profile info - you'll just see a generic "Valid" status.

Note: TMDB is a free service - there are no subscriptions, points, or usage quotas to track. The only extra data available via v4 is your username.

You can find both credentials on your TMDB API Settings page.
